title: Senior Videographer & Photographer
subline: Video production · Cinematography · Post-production · AI workflows
intro: I'm a Dubai-based videographer and photographer with 8+ years across commercials, corporate films, events, interiors and food. I shoot, light, edit and grade — from brief to final delivery — and I build AI tools into my workflow to deliver faster, while the creative decisions stay mine.

about.headline: I shoot, light, edit and grade —
about.photo_alt: Kashan Amjad operating a cinema camera on set
bio: I'm Kashan Amjad, a Dubai-based videographer and photographer with 8+ years in commercial, corporate and event production.

I've made films and photographs for brands like LG, Capital.com and Arabica, and for UAE government entities including MOFA and Etihad Credit Insurance. My strength is the whole chain: planning the approach, shooting, lighting, editing, colour grading and delivering the finished piece.

More and more of my work is AI-integrated. I use tools like Kling, Veo and Nano Banana to generate shots, build versions and speed up the edit — on the Dubai Investments National Day film, AI-generated footage made up around half of the cut. AI makes the process faster; the story, the framing and the final call are still made by hand.
Where I'm heading: cinematic and documentary filmmaking. My first film, Shabab (2019), was a short documentary for the DW × Dawn.com #ItOnlyHappensInPakistan contest.
